{{Quote|With the Trade Federation's comm web down, we have a short time to infiltrate a sleeping base and capture a gunboat.|Captain Kael, to his pilots|<ref name="Star Wars: Battle for Naboo" />}}
A '''base''' established by the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] was [[Disruption of Comm 4|disabled]] and [[Attack on disabled base|attacked]] by the [[Royal Naboo Security Forces/Legends|Royal Naboo Security Forces]] early in the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]]. The base had extensive defenses and was controlled by the Trade Federation comm web through [[Comm 4]], an [[Orbit/Legends|orbital]] [[Satellite/Legends|satellite]].

==Description==
A [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] installation was sequestered in the frozen glaciers of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]. The base primarily consisted of six platforms covered in [[Laser turret (Trade Federation)|laser turrets]], [[Missile launcher (Trade Federation)|missile launchers]], and other buildings. The base's command center was protected by a [[Deflector shield generator/Legends|deflector shield generator]]. Nearby lay the headwaters of the [[Andrevea River]], and passage further downriver was blocked off by a wall and water-based [[mines]]. [[C-9979 landing craft/Legends|C-9979 landing craft]] could land on a landing platform. The base also included a garrison of [[Vulture-class starfighter/Legends|droid starfighters]], and had a command staff of [[Neimoidian/Legends|Neimoidians]] and [[Droid/Legends|droids]]. Commands from the [[Central Control Computer/Legends|Central Control Computer]] were rerouted through the [[Orbit/Legends|orbital]] communications [[Satellite/Legends|satellite]] [[Comm 4]]. If the Trade Federation comm web was disrupted, the base would hibernate.<ref name="Star Wars: Battle for Naboo" />

{{GameMechanics|legends=1}}
The Trade Federation took over several settlements in the area and installed laser turrets near them. In one such settlement, in a canyon alcove near the control center, a building was burnt out and revealed the [[Proton bomb/Legends|advanced bomb]] technology it held. During his [[Squadron/Legends|squadron's]] [[Attack on disabled base|attack on the base]], [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Gavyn Sykes/Legends|Gavyn Sykes]] found the technology and picked it up.<ref name="Star Wars: Battle for Naboo" />
{{Endgame}}

==History==
When the [[Trade Federation Droid Army/Legends|Trade Federation Droid Army]] [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|invaded]] Naboo in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]],<ref name="The New Essential Chronology" /> the base was established. During the course of the invasion, the [[Naboo Resistance|Naboo resistance]] came up with a plan to strike back at the Trade Federation and free their people who were being held in [[Slavery/Legends|slave camps]]. The plan involved [[Disruption of Comm 4|knocking out]] Comm 4 to temporarily cut off the installation from the Central Control Computer, thereby shutting down the base. After destroying Comm 4, the [[Naboo (people)/Legends|Naboo]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] descended from orbit and began their sorties against the base. The Federation defenses unexpectedly reactivated and commenced firing on the Naboo [[Starfighter/Legends|ships]]. A C-9979 landing craft took off at the same time. Several droid starfighters took off to engage the Naboo pilots. Moving towards the command center, the pilots left most of the base in ruin. Upon reaching the command center, Lieutenant Sykes blew up the [[Deflector shield/Legends|shield]] generator protecting it. He was then ordered to land his [[N-1 starfighter/Legends|N-1 starfighter]] and steal a [[Ostracoda-class gunboat|gunboat]] in order to head down the river and [[Liberation of enslavement camps|liberate]] Federation [[Slavery/Legends|slave]] camps. His [[Wingmate/Legends|wingmen]] left the base before enemy reinforcements arrived.<ref name="Star Wars: Battle for Naboo" />

==Behind the scenes==
The base appears in a mission from the [[2000]] [[LucasArts]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Episode I: Battle for Naboo]]''. The player's objective is to destroy every Federation target. Picking up the upgrade fulfills the mission's bonus objective.
